author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Documents suggest Starship Flight 14 is targeting September 15, but Ship 41 and Booster 21 are still off the launch pad. With their pre-launch test campaigns complete, what still needs to happen before SpaceX’s next orbital mission?

In this Starship Update, we break down the latest vehicle preparations, signs of flight termination system installation, and the paperwork pointing toward Starlink V3 satellite deployment. We also explore why a booster or ship catch looks increasingly unlikely for Flight 14, and what remains unknown about the mission’s duration, orbital profile, and splashdown location.

Beyond Flight 14, Ship 42 completes cryogenic testing as Booster 22 awaits its own test campaign. Booster 23 and Ship 43 continue taking shape, while fresh aerial views reveal progress on Starbase’s launch pads, Starfactory, and GigaBay.

title: Starship Flight 14 Nears—So Where Is The Rocket? | Starship Update
